tint.mask: COLOR_0 alpha: above 0.75 = wall that takes the building's color, 0.25 to 0.75 = roof (see roof), below 0.25 = never tint
tint.hint: multiply masked faces by color / base (per channel): the wall then shows the color

roof.mask: COLOR_0 alpha 0.25 to 0.75 (written as 0.5): roof faces that take the district's roof color
roof.hint: multiply roof faces by roof color / base (per channel), the roof color being the district's (District.roof) in one of a few shades picked by the structure's id
